explanation: Seahorses are bony fish with gills and fins, and the male carries the eggs in a pouch on his belly until the young emerge. Starfish, jellyfish and cuttlefish are invertebrates.

claims.text: Seahorses are bony fish, with gills and fins.
Starfish (echinoderms), jellyfish (cnidarians) and cuttlefish (molluscs) are invertebrates, not fish.
Male seahorses carry the eggs in a brood pouch on the belly until the young emerge.
